It opened the individual point directly; the initial wait for a cluster table timed out, so inspected the current UI before proceeding. Record 131921613 reports 2G/generation 2, RxLevel, RxQual, ARFCN and BSIC.

Selected only 3G in the same configuration and applied. Two GET /api/platform/automobile/service/points requests returned HTTP 200 with [] in the current tile/time scope. No 3G detail fixture was available.
Selected only 5G NSA and opened a visible marker, then its second cluster row. Record 131928084 reports 5G NSA/generation 13 with RSRP, RSRQ, EARFCN and SINR. Inspected top and bottom KPI captures.
Selected only 5G SA and applied. The settled map had no selectable points in the current area/time scope; no 5G SA detail fixture was established.
Captured final empty scoped map, recorded GIS URL, inspected saved KPI and blocker images, closed owned tabs and removed the layer. This is partial generation coverage, not a five-generation pass.
reason: 2G, 4G and 5G NSA KPI labels were observed; 3G and 5G SA detail fixtures were unavailable in the inspected area/date scope. Map legend labels alone do not verify point detail labels.

criterion: Given loading Service point details fails, the detail presentation shows an error state and does not show incorrect detail data.
steps_taken: SIMULATED UI STATE: Restarted the entire criterion from a settled launcher after image QA found the earlier initial capture was still Initializing. Only the restart sequence supports this verdict.

Opened GIS > Automobile > Service, selected the genuine cluster, loaded distinct baseline point 131928136 and target 131928146 normally. Established the real target POST /api/platform/automobile/service/cluster-details pointId 131928146 and HTTP 200 response.

Closed only the owned target tab and returned to valid point 131928136; captured its baseline. Installed a page-owned handler for the exact development-origin endpoint, POST method and pointId 131928146, letting unmatched requests fall through.

SIMULATED UI STATE: Selected target 131928146 and locally fulfilled exactly one matching read with standard HTTP 503 Service Unavailable, text/plain body 'Service Unavailable'. No backend write or authentication interception occurred.
Observed alert 'Unable to load point details.' and Retry button; the active presentation contained no baseline or target field values or neighbour sections. Captured final error state and GIS URL.

In finally removed only the exact owned handler and its reference. Clicked Retry and verified genuine point 131928146 details recovered without error. Captured recovery and inspected restart launcher/error/recovery images.
Closed all owned detail tabs, removed the owned layer, captured cleanup and returned to launcher. No owned handler remained.
reason: SIMULATED UI STATE: Exact development-origin POST /api/platform/automobile/service/cluster-details for pointId 131928146 was locally given standard HTTP 503 Service Unavailable with text/plain body 'Service Unavailable'. This tests UI handling of a failed read, not an observed backend outage or failed measurement. The active view showed 'Unable to load point details.' and Retry without stale fields. Exact handler was removed in finally; Retry recovered genuine HTTP 200 target details and UI cleanup completed.

coverageChecks.assertion: A failed Service detail request shows a standard error state
The failed target request does not show incorrect or stale details from baseline point 131928136
